problems.title: Sum of Two Numbers
problems.statement:
Read two integers and print their **sum**.

Use this to check the import works before writing your own problems.

python.starter:
a = int(input())
b = int(input())

# Your code here
python.solution:
a = int(input())
b = int(input())
print(a + b)

hints: Read each number on its own line, then convert it to an integer.
problems.editorial: Read both numbers and print `a + b`. In C++ use `long long`: the sum can pass 2^31.
